moduleTitle: Automation shapes in the Case Life Cycle
learningObjectives: Explain how configurable Automation tasks simplify Case processing and identify which tasks involve user input
Identify the Automation shapes available in App Studio and choose the correct one for a requirement

elements.description: Automations simplify Case processing by providing configurable tasks, often performed by the system. Examples include email delivery, Case creation and data copying. The App Studio palette also lists Questionnaire, which asks a user for input; inspect each shape’s behavior rather than assuming every listed shape is purely system-side.

elements.text: Think of workflow helpers: some deliver a message or copy data automatically, while others pause for a dependency or ask someone a question. Choose the helper whose behavior matches the requirement; its presence in the palette does not mean every downstream task avoids human work.

elements.description: Two paths to add an Automation shape:
items: Case Life Cycle view: select a Step → More → Automations
Process modeler: Add → Automations (then configure with parameters specific to its purpose)

elements.description: Distinguish automatic actions from tasks that require people or pause processing:
items: Collect information requires a person to supply data.
Run Data Transform executes configured logic without asking a person to re-enter it.
Questionnaire asks a user to complete questions; Wait pauses until its configured condition is fulfilled.

studyGuide.sectionTitle: Automation shapes available in App Studio

elements.description: Change to a Stage = move to a SPECIFIC Stage. Change to next Stage = advance automatically. Change to previous Stage = return to the previously visited Stage. Three distinct shapes — each behaves differently.

CREATE CASE creates one or more Cases from the current Case, not necessarily only children. UPDATE A CASE targets the current Case or child Cases and descendants. PERSIST CASE makes a temporary Case permanent. SEARCH DUPLICATE CASES checks configured duplicate conditions.

ATTACH CONTENT associates a file, URL or note with a Case. CREATE PDF produces an attachment from a specified View; the reviewed topic notes that Constellation requires a workaround. GENERATE DOCUMENT handles Case documents and is a separate shape.

SEND EMAIL — formatted emails to custom recipients. SEND NOTIFICATION — notification over multiple Channels. PUSH NOTIFICATION — iOS/Android mobile alert for a pending Case action. POST TO PULSE — posts a message to the Pulse feed.
Key Automation shapes available in the Process modeler:
items: Run Data Transform executes a selected Rule.
Connect Generative AI uses configured prompts and response structures; enable and configure AI in application settings.
Wait pauses processing for a configured condition.
Questionnaire collects answers from a user. Decision branching is a separate workflow concept, not an additional item in this topic’s Automation table.

elements.caption: The reviewed table contains 18 entries, including Questionnaire. Palette entries differ in behavior and support; Create PDF is not supported out of the box in Constellation.

elements.description: Send automated email correspondence to all relevant parties with no user interaction. Example: an online store emails a customer about new offers. You configure how the application determines the recipient and compose the email content.

Run a selected Data Transform rule at runtime to set/copy/initialize Case data. Example: at checkout, if the billing address equals the shipping address, a Data Transform copies it automatically instead of making the customer re-enter it.

elements.title: Automation Shape Selector

examPitfalls.title: Avoid a universal no-user-action claim
examPitfalls.trapDescription: Many shapes perform system tasks, but the same reviewed table also includes Questionnaire. Creating a Case may initiate further work, and Wait deliberately pauses processing.
examPitfalls.bestPractice: Explain the selected shape’s behavior rather than asserting that every palette entry creates no Assignments or requires no user action.

examPitfalls.title: Create PDF vs Generate document
examPitfalls.trapDescription: These are two SEPARATE shapes. Create PDF renders a specified View into a PDF and attaches it; Generate document generates Case documents as part of the Case Life Cycle.
examPitfalls.bestPractice: PDF from a specific View → Create PDF. Case documents in the lifecycle → Generate document. (Constellation apps need a workaround for Create PDF.)

examPitfalls.title: Push notification vs Send notification vs Send email
examPitfalls.trapDescription: Push notification = iOS/Android mobile device. Send notification = recipients over MULTIPLE Channels. Send email = formatted emails to custom recipients. They are not interchangeable.
examPitfalls.bestPractice: Read the channel carefully: mobile device → Push notification; multi-Channel alert → Send notification; email message → Send email.

examPitfalls.title: Three Stage shapes, not one
examPitfalls.trapDescription: There are separate shapes for Change to a Stage (specific), Change to next Stage, and Change to the previous Stage.
examPitfalls.bestPractice: Pick the exact Stage shape: specific target, next, or previously visited.

examPitfalls.title: Persist Case = temporary → permanent
examPitfalls.trapDescription: Persist Case converts a temporary Case into a permanent object in the database — it is not a generic 'save data' step.
examPitfalls.bestPractice: Use Persist Case for the stated temporary-to-permanent transition; integration availability still depends on its own configuration.

examPitfalls.title: Wait pauses on a condition
examPitfalls.trapDescription: Wait pauses the Case until a specified condition is met — a timer OR a Case status (e.g., child Cases resolved).
examPitfalls.bestPractice: Need to hold the Case until something happens → Wait shape.

examPitfalls.title: Where to add Automations
examPitfalls.trapDescription: The add path differs by tool: Case Life Cycle uses Step > More > Automations; the Process modeler uses Add > Automations.
examPitfalls.bestPractice: Remember both entry points; the exam may name either tool.

practiceQuiz.scenario: In an application where PDF generation from a View is supported, which shape creates that PDF and attaches it automatically to the Case?

options.text: Create PDF — creates a PDF file from a specified View and attaches it to the Case
Collect information — displays a form to the user who must enter the PDF content manually
Attach content — the user attaches the View as a file to the Case
Questionnaire — the user completes a questionnaire that outputs the PDF

practiceQuiz.hint: PDF from a specified View, attached automatically = Create PDF.
practiceQuiz.rationale: Create PDF matches the requested View-to-attachment operation. The reviewed topic notes that Constellation needs a workaround; this question assumes supported generation rather than promising universal availability.

optionExplanations.A: This is the described View-to-PDF attachment task, with support assumed by the scenario rather than guaranteed for every application.
optionExplanations.B: Collect information solicits user data; it does not itself render the specified View into the requested PDF attachment.
optionExplanations.C: The offered upload action expects a file; it does not perform the required automatic conversion of a View.
optionExplanations.D: Questionnaire collects answers, which is different from rendering an existing View into a PDF attachment.

practiceQuiz.scenario: A Case should automatically spin off one or more related Cases when it reaches a specific Step. Which Automation shape?

options.text: Create Case — creates one or more Cases from the current Case automatically
Change to a Stage — moves the current Case to a different Stage, which spawns a Case
Update a Case — updating the current Case automatically creates its child Cases
Wait — pauses the Case until a child Case is created manually

practiceQuiz.hint: Create one or more Cases from the current Case = Create Case.
practiceQuiz.rationale: Create Case starts one or more related Cases from the current Case. Moving Stages or updating existing Case data does not by itself satisfy a requirement to create them.

optionExplanations.A: Case creation satisfies the need for new related work; the table does not restrict every created Case to child-only relationships.
optionExplanations.B: Changing a Stage navigates the current lifecycle; creating another Case would need its own configured task.
optionExplanations.C: Updating an existing Case is not equivalent to creating the new related Cases requested by the scenario.
optionExplanations.D: A manual-creation wait would defer the work rather than automatically create the required related Cases.

practiceQuiz.scenario: In the reviewed Automation table, how do the described purposes of Create PDF and Generate document differ?

options.text: Create PDF renders a specified View into a PDF and attaches it; Generate document generates Case documents as part of the Case Life Cycle
They are the same shape with two names; either generates any document from any source
Create PDF works only in Constellation; Generate document works only in the legacy UI
Generate document attaches files to a Case; Create PDF sends them by email

practiceQuiz.hint: One renders a View to PDF; the other generates Case documents.
practiceQuiz.rationale: The table distinguishes View-to-PDF attachment from Case document generation. This purpose comparison is not a guarantee that every UI architecture supports both out of the box.

optionExplanations.A: These descriptions distinguish the source View and attachment operation from the separate Case-document generation task.
optionExplanations.B: Different table entries have distinct described purposes; they are not interchangeable names for unrestricted document generation.
optionExplanations.C: The reviewed source explicitly warns of a Constellation PDF workaround, contradicting the claimed Constellation-only Create PDF support.
optionExplanations.D: The stated delivery distinction is wrong: Create PDF attaches its output rather than being defined as an email-sending task.

practiceQuiz.scenario: At the end of a Process the system must run a Data Transform rule to copy the shipping address into the billing address fields — no Assignment, no message. Which shape?

options.text: Run Data Transform — runs the selected Data Transform rule at runtime to set/copy Case data without user interaction
Approve/Reject — automatically evaluates the addresses and approves the copy
Send notification — notifies the customer that the addresses were copied
Connect Generative AI — prompts Pega GenAI to copy the address values

practiceQuiz.hint: Run a Data Transform at runtime to copy fields = Run Data Transform.
practiceQuiz.rationale: Run Data Transform executes a Data Transform rule at runtime to copy/initialize Case data — the exact checkout use case. B is wrong because Approve/Reject is a human decision step. C is wrong because Send notification sends a message, not field copies. D is wrong because Connect Generative AI is for GenAI prompts/responses, not deterministic field copying.

optionExplanations.A: Executing the selected transformation directly matches deterministic field copying; the scenario does not require user approval or messaging.
optionExplanations.B: Approval is a different workflow purpose and does not identify the requested selected Data Transform execution.
optionExplanations.C: Delivering a notification does not execute the selected address-copy transformation; messaging would be an additional requirement.
optionExplanations.D: A model prompt is not the requested deterministic execution of a selected Data Transform Rule.

practiceQuiz.scenario: Which THREE names appear in the reviewed App Studio Automation table?

options.text: Search duplicate Cases — automatically searches for duplicate Cases using set conditions
Post to Pulse — creates a message and posts it to the Pulse social stream
Connect Generative AI — uses customized Pega GenAI rules (define prompt and response structure)
Call REST API — invokes an external REST service directly as an Automation shape

practiceQuiz.hint: Three are in the App Studio Automation table; one is not.
practiceQuiz.rationale: Search duplicate Cases, Post to Pulse and Connect Generative AI are listed names. Call REST API is not a listed name in this topic; that does not imply Pega cannot integrate with REST services.

optionExplanations.A: This name is in the reviewed table and checks configured duplicate conditions; it is not a claim that duplicates are automatically merged.
optionExplanations.B: This listed task posts a message to the Pulse stream, rather than creating a document or copying Case data.
optionExplanations.C: This listed task configures a GenAI prompt and response structure; availability requires AI enablement and configuration.
optionExplanations.D: This exact name is absent from the reviewed table; that distinction does not deny the platform’s REST integration capabilities.

practiceQuiz.scenario: A parent Case must pause until all its child Cases are resolved before continuing. Which Automation shape?

options.text: Wait — pauses the Case until a specified condition is fulfilled, such as a timer or a Case status
Persist Case — pauses the Case until the children are written to the database
Change to next Stage — advances the Case, which waits for children automatically
Update a Case — updating children pauses the parent until they finish

practiceQuiz.hint: Pause until a condition (timer / Case status) = Wait.
practiceQuiz.rationale: Wait provides the configured pause for the required Case-status dependency. The other shapes create permanence, change a Stage or update data rather than supplying that wait.

optionExplanations.A: A configured Case-status wait supplies the pause required by the parent workflow; the dependency still needs to be configured.
optionExplanations.B: Permanence of a temporary Case is unrelated to waiting for the children’s required completion state.
optionExplanations.C: Advancing a Stage does not imply an automatic child-completion dependency; the requested pause must be modeled.
optionExplanations.D: Updating children does not itself provide the specified parent wait; status-based coordination is the requirement here.

practiceQuiz.scenario: A workflow has a temporary Case and must explicitly convert it to a permanent database object. Which shape describes that transition?

options.text: Persist Case — converts a temporary Case to a permanent object in the database
Update a Case — updates the current Case, which also commits it to the database
Attach content — attaching a file forces the Case to be saved
Generate document — generating a document persists the Case as a side effect

practiceQuiz.hint: Temporary → permanent in the DB = Persist Case.
practiceQuiz.rationale: Persist Case converts a temporary Case into a permanent object in the database. B is wrong because Update a Case updates Case data (current Case or children/descendants) and is not the shape defined for converting temporary to permanent. C and D are wrong because attaching content or generating a document are not mechanisms for persisting a temporary Case.

optionExplanations.A: This task explicitly makes the temporary Case permanent, matching the stated lifecycle transition.
optionExplanations.B: Updating data is not the table’s defined temporary-to-permanent conversion task; do not infer the transition from an update.
optionExplanations.C: Attaching content serves a content-association purpose, not the explicitly requested permanence transition in this table.
optionExplanations.D: Document generation produces documents; it is not the shape defined for converting a temporary Case into a permanent object.

practiceQuiz.scenario: A workflow must alert participants over multiple Channels (not just email, not just mobile) when a milestone is reached. Which shape?

options.text: Send notification — sends a notification to recipients over multiple Channels
Push notification — sends a notification to an iOS or Android mobile device
Send email — sends formatted emails to custom recipients
Post to Pulse — posts a message to the Pulse social stream

practiceQuiz.hint: Choose the shape described for notification delivery over multiple channels; configure the actual recipients and channels.
practiceQuiz.rationale: Send notification delivers a notification to recipients over multiple Channels. B is wrong because Push notification targets a mobile device specifically. C is wrong because Send email is email only. D is wrong because Post to Pulse writes to the social stream, a single mechanism, not multi-Channel notification.

optionExplanations.A: This table entry is described for multiple-channel notification; actual recipients and channels still require configuration.
optionExplanations.B: The phone-specific task addresses a narrower device alert, not the broader multi-channel requirement stated here.
optionExplanations.C: An email message addresses one delivery mechanism; it does not identify the table’s multi-channel notification entry.
optionExplanations.D: A Pulse post addresses the stream, not the specifically described notification task across multiple channels.

practiceQuiz.scenario: A workflow reaches a Run Data Transform step configured to copy an address. Which statement describes this specific step’s behavior?

options.text: It executes the selected Data Transform automatically rather than asking the user to re-enter the address
They always display a form and wait for user input before executing
They can only be added in the Process modeler, never in the Case Life Cycle
They authenticate the operator before each Automation executes

practiceQuiz.hint: Consider the specified data-copy action, rather than every entry in the Automation palette.
practiceQuiz.rationale: Run Data Transform executes configured data operations. This answer concerns that specific task; it does not generalize to user-facing Questionnaire or every possible consequence of creating another Case.

optionExplanations.A: The selected transformation performs the configured copy directly; user re-entry is not required by this task.
optionExplanations.B: This data-copy task does not always present a form; that behavior belongs to user-input requirements.
optionExplanations.C: The topic provides both Case Life Cycle and Process modeler entry points, so the modeler-only claim is incorrect.
optionExplanations.D: Per-task authentication is not the described function of this transformation; the configured data operation answers the question.

practiceQuiz.scenario: A workflow must update existing child Cases and their descendants. Which shape in the reviewed table supports that target?

options.text: Update a Case — updates the current Case or all child Cases and descendants
Create Case — creates the children and updates them at the same time
Run Data Transform — a Data Transform always cascades to child Cases automatically
Change to a Stage — moving Stage updates all descendants

practiceQuiz.hint: Update current Case OR all children/descendants = Update a Case.
practiceQuiz.rationale: Update a Case supports the current Case or child/descendant target described in the table. Configure the intended target; do not assume that selecting it always updates both the current Case and every descendant.

optionExplanations.A: The reviewed table includes updates to child Cases and descendants; configure that target instead of assuming a universal combined update.
optionExplanations.B: Creating new Cases does not satisfy the requirement to update the specified existing children and descendants.
optionExplanations.C: A transformation does not always cascade automatically to children; such behavior requires explicit configuration rather than this absolute claim.
optionExplanations.D: Stage navigation is not a guarantee that descendant data changes; lifecycle navigation and updates are separate requirements.

practiceQuiz.scenario: An SA needs an Automation that uses customized Pega GenAI rules — defining the prompt sent to the model and the structure of the response. Which shape, and what is the prerequisite?

options.text: Connect Generative AI — and generative AI must be enabled/configured in the application settings
Run Data Transform — no prerequisite; Data Transforms include GenAI prompts
Send notification — GenAI responses are delivered as notifications
Questionnaire — GenAI fills the questionnaire answers automatically

practiceQuiz.hint: GenAI prompt + response structure = Connect Generative AI (needs GenAI enabled).
practiceQuiz.rationale: Connect Generative AI uses customized Pega GenAI rules; you define the prompt and the response structure, and generative AI must be enabled/configured in application settings. B, C, and D describe unrelated shapes that do not provide GenAI prompt/response configuration.

optionExplanations.A: The customized prompt/response task fits, and the reviewed source explicitly requires enabling and configuring generative AI.
optionExplanations.B: A Data Transform does not inherently supply GenAI prompts or eliminate the application’s AI configuration prerequisite.
optionExplanations.C: Notification delivery is not the requested customized prompt/response operation; a generated result may be used separately.
optionExplanations.D: Collecting questionnaire answers does not automatically configure or execute the requested customized GenAI operation.

practiceQuiz.scenario: Which TWO statements correctly pair a need with the right Stage-navigation Automation shape?

options.text: Return the Case to the Stage it was in before → Change to the previous Stage
Advance the Case to the following Stage automatically → Change to next Stage
Jump to any specific Stage → Change to next Stage
Return to the previously visited Stage → Change to next Stage

practiceQuiz.hint: Previous = previously visited; next = the following Stage; specific target = Change to a Stage.
practiceQuiz.rationale: The previous-Stage and next-Stage shapes match their respective navigation requirements. Selecting an arbitrary target is a different operation; next does not mean previous or any chosen Stage.

optionExplanations.A: The previous-Stage task matches returning to the visited Stage; it is different from choosing any arbitrary target.
optionExplanations.B: The next-Stage task matches advancing to the following Stage rather than returning to a previous one.
optionExplanations.C: A specific target is chosen with Change to a Stage; next is not synonymous with any desired Stage.
optionExplanations.D: Next does not mean previously visited; use the previous-Stage task for that return requirement.

practiceQuiz.scenario: A Claims workflow uses Send email and Run Data Transform for configured system tasks. Which TWO statements correctly describe these two steps?

options.text: They execute the configured email or data operation without asking a person to perform that operation manually
They can run as steps in Case processing when the workflow reaches them
Automation shapes always require a human approver to confirm the action before the automation executes
Automation shapes in App Studio are restricted to sending emails and cannot perform other types of system actions

practiceQuiz.hint: The question concerns two specified system tasks, not a claim about all palette entries.
practiceQuiz.rationale: These two configured system tasks can execute at their workflow steps without requiring a person to perform the email delivery or data copy manually. Questionnaire behavior is different and is not generalized by this example.

optionExplanations.A: These specified tasks perform their configured operations automatically; this is not a universal assertion about Questionnaire or other tasks.
optionExplanations.B: Case processing can include these configured steps, so reaching the step can initiate the relevant operation.
optionExplanations.C: A mandatory human confirmation for every email or data-copy task contradicts the described configured automatic operation.
optionExplanations.D: The table includes data operations, navigation and other tasks besides email, so the email-only restriction is incorrect.

quickRecap.value: Configurable tasks can simplify processing; inspect each task. Many actions run automatically, while Questionnaire asks a user and Wait pauses.
Case Life Cycle: Step > More > Automations. Process modeler: Add > Automations.
Change to a Stage (specific) · Change to next Stage · Change to the previous Stage.
Create related Cases; update the configured Case target; make a temporary Case permanent; check duplicate conditions.
View-to-PDF attachment and Case document generation are distinct. The reviewed topic notes Constellation needs a Create PDF workaround.
Send email (custom recipients) · Send notification (multi-Channel) · Push notification (mobile device) · Post to Pulse.
Run selected data logic, configure GenAI, pause with Wait or collect answers with Questionnaire; behavior differs by task.
